rationale: Volt-VAR curve designed to mitigate voltage violations at t_low (0.94 pu, below limit) and t_high (1.07 pu, above limit). At t_low, injecting 14.3 kVAR raises voltage to 0.95 pu. At t_high, absorbing 28.6 kVAR lowers voltage to 1.05 pu. At t_nom (1.0 pu), no reactive power needed. Curve is strictly monotonic non-increasing with all reactive power commands within inverter capability.
